text:
Nina: Hi team, day 1 complete. Quick sanity check: I got a laptop but missing some access. Where do I ask for: 1) VPN, 2) badge pickup, 3) repo perms, 4) GCP project access, and 5) stop onboarding DMs? Trying to keep things tidy.
IT Help: Welcome Nina! Short answers: VPN -> #help with subject 'vpn', include your office or home region. Badge -> #people-ops with full name + office. Repo perms -> fill Access Form (link in #devex pinned) then ping @DevEx if it stalls. GCP access -> open ticket in #eng-infra with project id and IAM role. To stop DMs -> see OnboardBot below.
DevEx: Also, for repo perms include the exact repo slug and your GH handle. If you need write access for multiple repos, attach a short justification.
Nina: Cool. Is it okay to post access requests in my team channel first or should it always go to the global channels?
Marcus: Team channel is fine for team-scoped stuff (e.g., test infra repos). Global infra requests (network, cloud, org-level perms) -> #eng-infra or #help. If you start in team channel, thread the request and summarize the outcome to #eng or #devex so infra can triage.
OnboardBot: Commands to control onboarding: `/onboard prefs` -> opens DM with toggles, `/onboard pause` -> pause messages for 7 days, `/onboard stop` -> unsubscribe. You can also click "Manage" in the welcome DM to set email and reminder cadence.
Taylor: Etiquette notes: use reactions for quick acks, avoid @channel unless outage/office-wide, keep one question per thread for easier search. For anything security-related, DM the security lead and post a short incident note to #eng-security (do not share secrets).
